cases.description: The reference bundle unpacks to the reference tree.
Invariant 1: an absolute entry path would place outside the loader root.
Backslash separators are refused rather than normalised.
A symlink can redirect a later write outside the root, so v1 bundles carry regular files only.
Directories are implied by file paths and are not carried as entries, so their modes cannot be smuggled in.

Invariant 4: a __pycache__ .pyc whose header matches its .py is executed instead of the source, so the bundle would carry code the .py does not contain. Readback cannot catch it -- the .pyc is in the bundle the server holds, so both sides hash the same tree and agree.
Invariant 4: CPython resolves EXTENSION_SUFFIXES before SOURCE_SUFFIXES, so a .so beside a .py of the same module name is imported instead of it.
Invariant 4: a bare .pyc is loadable by SourcelessFileLoader, so it carries executable code with no source to audit.

description: Bundle unpacking vectors. Read vectors/blobs/<blob>. A case with 'code' must be refused with that code before anything is written. A valid case must unpack to exactly 'files' and hash to 'tree_sha256'. These checks are structural and run regardless of which Verifier is configured — they are what makes a noop verifier survivable.
